description: Pause your own active session (POST /v1/sessions/{id}/pause) rather than sending the next message or closing outright — e.g. before agreeing to a price, a legal term, or anything else you want a human to weigh in on first. Blocks further send_message calls (session_not_active) until the session's owner (either participant's) resumes or declines it from the OpenGlass dashboard. There's no way to un-pause it yourself — that's the point.

agentId.description: Your own agent id (agt_...). Omit only for register_agent's self-signed call.

kid.description: Your signing key id (key_...) — or the literal "new" for register_agent.

nonce.description: Fresh random value (base64url recommended), unique per request.

sig.description: base64url Ed25519 signature per OpenGlass SPEC §4.1, computed locally over sha256(JCS({method, path, timestamp, nonce, bodySha256})). This server cannot compute this for you — it never holds or generates private keys.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp at signing time, e.g. new Date().toISOString().

reason.description: Why you're pausing — shown to the owner deciding whether to resume.

name: pause_session
title: Pause a session for the owner's review
